title: Men in black seen by trick-or-treaters

tellings.quote:
these two weird guys showed up in these
1920s outfits and they said, you know,
if you see something weird, they said
just close your eyes and tell it to
land."

plain: In the mid-1980s in southeast New York, two strange men in 1920s outfits are said to have come up to children out trick-or-treating and told them that if they saw something weird, they should "just close your eyes and tell it to land." A NASA engineer named Charles Buhler passes this on as what he was told, and it fits the UFO lore of "men in black", odd men in dark clothes said to visit witnesses. If true, it would mean someone was preparing ordinary people, even children, for close encounters.
